known_facts_book1: A little Munchkin boy who has lived all his life alone with his uncle in the Blue Forest of the Munchkin Country.
Is called 'Ojo the Unlucky' because he was born on a Friday, on the thirteenth of the month, is left-handed and has a wart under his right arm.
Wears the native Munchkin costume: blue silk stockings, blue knee-pants with gold buckles, and a peaked hat rimmed with tiny golden bells.
Secretly pours every bottle on the 'Brain Furniture' shelf into the dish of brains Margolotte is preparing, which is why the Patchwork Girl has far more brains than intended.

Sets out to find the five things Dr. Pipt's recipe requires to undo the Liquid of Petrifaction: a six-leaved clover, the left wing of a yellow butterfly, a gill of water from a dark well, three hairs from a Woozy's tail, and a drop of oil from a live man's body.
Picks a six-leaved clover beside the road after being warned it is against the Law, hides it in his basket, and hands the basket to Scraps.
Is arrested at the gate of the Emerald City by the Soldier with the Green Whiskers and jailed in Tollydiggle's house, the only prison in Oz.
Confesses at his trial before Ozma, is forgiven, and is allowed to keep the already-picked clover.
Fills Dorothy's gold flask at the dark well in Diksey's radium mine, in the dark, so no light ever reaches the water.
Catches a drop of oil falling from the Tin Woodman's left knee-joint in a crystal vial, obtaining the fourth item.
Fails to get the fifth item because the Tin Woodman forbids harming a yellow butterfly; the Wizard restores Unc Nunkie and Margolotte by Glinda's method instead.
Is given a house just outside the walls of the Emerald City by Ozma, and is renamed Ojo the Lucky by the Tin Woodman.

known_relations_book1.Unc Nunkie: His uncle and only guardian, whom he journeys to restore from marble.
known_relations_book1.Scraps: The Patchwork Girl, his first friend, who travels with him and hides his stolen clover.
known_relations_book1.Bungle: The Glass Cat, a travelling companion who guides them in the dark but refuses to risk herself.
known_relations_book1.the Woozy: A square beast he befriends with bread and cheese and takes along because the three tail hairs cannot be pulled out.
known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: Rescues him from the clutching plants and guides him to the Emerald City.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Joins his quest and lends him the gold flask for the dark-well water.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler who orders his arrest for breaking the Law, then forgives him and gives him a home.
known_relations_book1.Dr. Pipt: The Crooked Magician who sends him on the quest for the five things.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: Gives him the drop of oil, but refuses him the butterfly wing.

known_facts_book1: An aged white-bearded Munchkin, Ojo's uncle, who speaks in single words and is known as the Silent One.
Is the descendant of the former kings of the Munchkins, and might have been King himself had the Munchkins not accepted Ozma as sole ruler.
Has lived alone with his baby nephew in a lonesome round house in the Blue Forest until the food in their garden runs out.
Is an old friend of Dr. Pipt from many years back, which is why he leads Ojo to the Crooked Magician's house.
Touches the bottle marked 'Cleverness' and says 'Little', suggesting the Patchwork Girl be given a little cleverness.
Is turned to solid marble, beard and all, when his head joggles the shelf and upsets the Liquid of Petrifaction over himself and Margolotte.
Stands as a marble statue for the whole of Ojo's journey, and is brought by Ozma to the palace.
Is restored to life by the Wizard's magic pass and magic word, and says only 'Thanks'.

known_relations_book1.Ojo: His nephew, whom he raised alone in the forest and who journeys to save him.
known_relations_book1.Dr. Pipt: An old friend from many years past, in whose workshop he is petrified.
known_relations_book1.Margolotte: Petrified in the same accident and restored at the same moment.
